heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1P handles Prusament PLA exceptionally well right out of the box on its stock stainless steel nozzle without needing an enclosure. Leveraging a maximum volumetric flow rate of 20 mm³/s, the machine safely sustains printing speeds up to 238 mm/s with stellar layer quality.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (cleaned with warm water and dish soap, no adhesive required)
slicerTweaks: Set Max Volumetric Speed to 20 mm³/s in the Filament Settings to cap extrusion throughput safely below the melt limit.
Configure Nozzle Temperature to 220°C for high-speed infill and outer walls, stepping down to 210°C for the first layer to maximize detail.
Set Pressure Advance to 0.022 in OrcaSlicer filament overrides to eliminate corner bulging during high-acceleration moves.
Enable auxiliary cooling fan at 70-80% alongside the 100% part cooling fan to maintain sharp overhangs at elevated print speeds.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Fine stringing and cobwebbing across travel moves
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Prusament PLA exhibits low melt viscosity at high nozzle temperatures when combined with direct drive wipe lag.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Enable 'Wipe while retracting' (2mm) in OrcaSlicer extruder settings and lower nozzle temperature from 220°C to 212°C.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Under-extrusion and matte banding during long linear runs
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Exceeding the thermal transfer capacity of the stock stainless steel nozzle at speeds above 238 mm/s.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Enforce the 20 mm³/s Max Volumetric Flow cap and ensure printing speed does not surpass 238 mm/s on 0.2mm layer heights.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Corner lifting or warping on wide flat parts
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PEI bed surface contamination or ambient drafts acting on the open-frame P1P chassis.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Wash the Textured PEI plate with hot water and dawn dish soap, set bed temperature to 58°C, and disable the auxiliary fan for the first 5 layers.

faq.question: Does Prusament PLA require a hardened steel nozzle upgrade on the Bambu P1P?
faq.answer: No, standard Prusament PLA is non-abrasive and prints safely with the stock 0.4mm stainless steel nozzle without causing premature wear.

faq.question: Can I print Prusament PLA with an enclosed P1P or should the chamber stay open?
faq.answer: Because the P1P is open-frame by default, it is ideal for PLA; if you have added an aftermarket enclosure, keep the door or top glass vented to prevent heat creep.

faq.question: Why cap the print speed at 238 mm/s when the P1P can physically move faster?
faq.answer: At standard 0.2mm layer heights and 0.42mm line widths, 238 mm/s translates to exactly 20 mm³/s volumetric throughput, which matches the reliable hotend melting limit for Prusament PLA.

faq.question: Do I need glue stick on the Bambu Textured PEI plate for Prusament PLA?
faq.answer: No, Prusament PLA releases cleanly from the textured PEI surface once cooled; a glue stick is unnecessary and can degrade bottom-layer finish.
